hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: api
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: the url for the api calls

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/usr/bin/env bash set -euo pipefail
LOG_TS() { date +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z"; } log() { echo "[$(LOG_TS)] INFO $*" >&2; } error() { echo "[$(LOG_TS)] ERROR $*" >&2; }
api="${api:-http://dictionaryetl:8086/api}" ROLE_ARN="${ROLE_ARN:-arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl}" ROLE_SESSION_NAME="${ROLE_SESSION_NAME:-s3-test}" ASSUME_DURATION_SECONDS="${ASSUME_DURATION_SECONDS:-3600}" S3_BUCKET="${S3_BUCKET:-avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl}" MANAGED_INPUTS_KEY="general/resources/Managed_Inputs.csv" MANAGED_INPUTS_URI="s3://${S3_BUCKET}/${MANAGED_INPUTS_KEY}" ERROR_LOG="error_log.txt"
need() { command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { error "Missing required command: $1"; exit 2; }; } need curl need aws need jq
cleanup() { rm -f "${assume_json:-}" "${managed_inputs_file:-}" 2>/dev/null || true unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN } trap cleanup EXIT
# Initialize error log > "$ERROR_LOG"
log "Assuming role for S3 access: ${ROLE_ARN}" assume_json="$(mktemp)" aws sts assume-role \ --duration-seconds "$ASSUME_DURATION_SECONDS" \ --role-arn "$ROLE_ARN" \ --role-session-name "$ROLE_SESSION_NAME" \ > "$assume_json"
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID="$(jq -r '.Credentials.AccessKeyId' "$assume_json")" AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY="$(jq -r '.Credentials.SecretAccessKey' "$assume_json")" AWS_SESSION_TOKEN="$(jq -r '.Credentials.SessionToken' "$assume_json")"
log "Downloading Managed Inputs from ${MANAGED_INPUTS_URI}" managed_inputs_file="$(mktemp)" aws s3 cp "$MANAGED_INPUTS_URI" "$managed_inputs_file" --no-progress
total_count=0 success_count=0 error_count=0
# Skip header row and loop over managed inputs while IFS=',' read -r abv_name stdy_id stdy_type data_ready data_processed has_multi; do total_count=$((total_count + 1)) log "Processing study ${total_count}: ${stdy_id}"
OUT_DIR="./${stdy_id}" OUT_FILE="${OUT_DIR}/vars.tsv" S3_KEY="dictionary/${stdy_id}/vars.tsv" S3_URI="s3://${S3_BUCKET}/${S3_KEY}"
mkdir -p "$OUT_DIR"
# 1. Generate the stigvars file log "Fetching stigvars TSV from ${api} (ref=${stdy_id})" if ! curl --fail --show-error --silent \ "${api}/concept/metadata/stigvars?ref=${stdy_id}" \ > "$OUT_FILE" 2>&1; then error "Failed to fetch stigvars for ${stdy_id}" echo "[$(LOG_TS)] ${stdy_id}: curl request failed" >> "$ERROR_LOG" error_count=$((error_count + 1)) continue fi
# 2. Validate the file if [[ ! -s "$OUT_FILE" ]]; then error "Downloaded vars.tsv is empty for ${stdy_id}" echo "[$(LOG_TS)] ${stdy_id}: downloaded file is empty" >> "$ERROR_LOG" error_count=$((error_count + 1)) continue fi
# Check if file contains JSON error response (status 500, Internal Server Error) if head -c 1 "$OUT_FILE" | grep -q '{'; then if jq -e 'select(.status == 500 and .error == "Internal Server Error")' "$OUT_FILE" >/dev/null 2>&1; then error_path=$(jq -r '.path // "unknown"' "$OUT_FILE") error "API returned 500 error for ${stdy_id}: path=${error_path}" echo "[$(LOG_TS)] ${stdy_id}: API returned 500 Internal Server Error (path: ${error_path})" >> "$ERROR_LOG" error_count=$((error_count + 1)) continue fi fi
# 3. Upload valid file to S3 log "Uploading ${OUT_FILE} -> ${S3_URI}" if ! aws s3 cp "$OUT_FILE" "$S3_URI" --no-progress; then error "Failed to upload to S3 for ${stdy_id}" echo "[$(LOG_TS)] ${stdy_id}: S3 upload failed" >> "$ERROR_LOG" error_count=$((error_count + 1)) continue fi
log "Successfully processed ${stdy_id}" success_count=$((success_count + 1))
done < <(tail -n +2 "$managed_inputs_file")
log "Processing complete: ${success_count}/${total_count} successful, ${error_count} errors"
if [[ $error_count -gt 0 ]]; then log "Errors were logged to ${ERROR_LOG}" cat "$ERROR_LOG" >&2 fi
